name: Kobe (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kobe city emblem in white: a bifoliate fan-shaped mark derived from the old kana spelling かうべ (kaube).
history: The emblem was adopted in 1907, stylising the old kana spelling of the city's name; it is also read as two overlapping fans recalling Kobe's ports.

features.role: Kobe city emblem — a fan-shaped mark from the kana かうべ
features.symbolism: stylises the historical kana spelling of Kobe and evokes the twin fans of the city's harbours
